ENR 5.4 AIR NAVIGATION OBSTACLES

Note:  in the Netherlands an 'air navigation obstacle' is defined as any building or structure, including waste heaps, with a height of 328 FT AGL or more. The authority does not guarantee that the details are correct or that the list of obstacles is complete.
